description: #749 one-hop def/use regressions: an untrusted-source assignment one line above a path construction must fire even when the construction is a trusted-anchor call (path.resolve(__dirname, name), os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), name), a pathlib chain joinpath) — the anchor neutralization must be refused so the construction survives to be scanned. The plain non-anchor one-hop join keeps firing under the tightened def/use rule, and a formatted multi-line join with nested calls keeps its operand surface (the balanced-paren accumulator tracks nesting and scans through to the outer close). Declaration keywords are separate tokens (value/variable/constant/localpath one-hop fire), and division operands are isolated from sibling statements.
